zh: 昨晚发生了一次严重的服务中断，网站两个小时都打不开。
en: There was a major {outage} last night and the website was down for two hours.

zh: 升级服务器之前一定要做备份。
en: Always make a {backup} before you upgrade the server.

zh: 防火墙拦截了这个连接。
en: The {firewall} is blocking the connection.

zh: 视频通话很占带宽。
en: Video calls use a lot of {bandwidth|data}.

zh: 延迟太高，海外用户会觉得应用很慢。
en: High {latency} makes the app feel slow for overseas users.

zh: 你没有删除这个文件夹所需的权限。
en: You don't have the right {permissions} to delete this folder.

zh: 我们每个月都安装安全补丁。
en: We install security {patches|updates|fixes} every month.

zh: 回家前把代码推送到代码仓库。
en: Push your code to the {repository|repo} before you go home.

zh: 你可以在仪表盘上看到所有实时数据。
en: You can see all the live numbers on the {dashboard}.

zh: 我们在测试时发现了三个程序错误。
en: We found three {bugs|issues|defects|problems|errors} during testing.

zh: 我又忘了密码。
en: I forgot my {password} again.

zh: 你最多可以在五台设备上登录。
en: You can sign in on up to five {devices}.

zh: 新的发布版本周四上线。
en: The new {release|version|update} goes out on Thursday.

zh: 因为配置错误，部署失败了。
en: The {deployment|deploy} failed because of a config error.

zh: 查一下日志，看看哪里出了问题。
en: Check the {logs} to see what went wrong.

zh: 有些数据库查询要十秒以上。
en: Some database {queries} take more than ten seconds.

zh: 所有客户记录都存在一个数据库里。
en: All the customer records are stored in a {database}.

zh: 客户一直在改需求。
en: The client keeps changing the {requirements}.

zh: 如果笔记本电脑开不了机，就打电话给IT服务台。
en: If your laptop won't start, call the IT {helpdesk|help desk|service desk}.

zh: 我们需要为升级安排一段停机时间。
en: We need to schedule some {downtime} for the upgrade.

zh: 文件服务器的存储空间快用完了。
en: We're running out of {storage|space} on the file server.

zh: 扫描在旧系统里发现了几个安全漏洞。
en: The scan found several {vulnerabilities|weaknesses|holes} in the old system.

zh: 千万不要把你的登录凭据告诉别人。
en: Never share your login {credentials|details} with anyone.

zh: 数据通过加密来保护。
en: The data is protected by {encryption}.

zh: 目前还没有修复，但我找到了一个临时解决办法。
en: There's no fix yet, but I found a {workaround}.

zh: 每个功能都新建一个分支。
en: Create a new {branch} for each feature.

zh: 我键盘上有几个键卡住了，没法打字。
en: I can't type because some keys on my {keyboard} are stuck.

zh: 键盘快捷键能省很多时间。
en: Keyboard {shortcuts} save a lot of time.

zh: 我办公桌上用两台显示器工作。
en: I work with two {monitors|screens|displays} at my desk.

zh: 我把笔记本电脑的充电器忘在家里了。
en: I left my laptop {charger} at home.

zh: 我桌子底下的电线太多了。
en: There are too many {cables|wires|cords|leads} under my desk.

zh: 你可以在设置里更改语言。
en: You can change the language in the {settings}.

zh: 我把手机上所有的通知都关掉了。
en: I turned off all {notifications|alerts} on my phone.

zh: 用户名里不能有空格。
en: Your {username|user name} can't contain any spaces.

zh: 免费试用期三十天后结束。
en: The free {trial} ends after thirty days.

zh: 我们需要给新员工再买十个许可证。
en: We need to buy ten more {licences|licenses} for the new staff.

zh: 把文件保存到共享文件夹里。
en: Save the file in the shared {folder|drive}.

zh: 我不小心删了一些重要文件。
en: I accidentally deleted some important {files|documents}.

zh: 你用哪个浏览器，Chrome还是Firefox？
en: Which {browser} do you use, Chrome or Firefox?

zh: 试试清除浏览器缓存，然后重新登录。
en: Try clearing your browser {cache} and logging in again.

zh: 这家公司在一次安全泄露事件中丢失了客户数据。
en: The company lost customer data in a security {breach|incident}.

zh: 我们积压了一大堆支持请求。
en: We have a huge {backlog|pile|queue} of support requests.

zh: 我写了一个脚本，自动给所有文件重命名。
en: I wrote a {script|program} to rename all the files automatically.

zh: 先在预发布环境里测试一下。
en: Test it in the staging {environment} first.

zh: 如果无线网断了，试试重启路由器。
en: Try restarting the {router|modem} if the wifi stops working.

zh: 我没法给你打电话，这里没信号。
en: I can't call you because there's no {signal|reception|coverage} here.

zh: 你邮件的第二行有个打错的字。
en: There's a {typo|mistake} in the second line of your email.

zh: 你能把报错信息截个图发给我吗？
en: Can you send me a {screenshot} of the error message?

zh: 笔记本电脑的电池用几年后就不那么耐用了。
en: Laptop {batteries} don't last as long after a few years.

zh: 杀毒软件可以保护你的电脑不受恶意软件侵害。
en: Antivirus software protects your computer from {malware}.
